purpose: Diagnose the pinned simulator reward interface and qualify transition indexing before development use
prospective_hypotheses: The effective MixedReward.__call__ is its later dict-observation definition; StepMixedReward passes an unsupported laser_scan keyword and a flat observation.
The pinned step wrapper selects reward column one. ProgressReward appends zero at that column for a two-observation input, so a class-name alias alone cannot recover progress reward.

The frozen v2 shared progress reward uses the departure row, while its checkpoint reward uses the arrival row. A transition-aligned candidate must assign both to the departure row before reading new outcomes.
Stored archive reward at a horizon cutoff may include the cutoff row, whereas the declared common calculation zeros it.

The source checkpoint class can duplicate a full-lap threshold. Recording membership, horizon, discount and truncation may also explain published aggregate differences; compare each separately without selecting the closest total.

smoke_rollout.start: first public centerline point with heading toward the next point, velocity 0.5 m/s
smoke_rollout.stop: first termination or truncation, or 250 executed control steps
smoke_rollout.output: local step states and reward contributions; only compact summary in git

archive_trace.scope: all eligible real evaluation-agent development recordings under the previously adopted corrected exclusion; no reserved driving bags
archive_trace.private_output: outside git with per-record values and differences
archive_trace.public_output: compact counts, difference distributions and named causes without row-level data
archive_trace.unknown: published Groundtruth recording membership and original generating revision
